title: 午前二時の嘘
description: The things we say under a streetlight at 2am.
descriptionJa: 街灯の下、午前二時にだけ口にする言葉。

title: 夜に溺れる
description: Sinking into the dark and not wanting to be saved.
descriptionKo: 어둠에 가라앉는데, 구해지고 싶지 않은 기분.
descriptionJa: 闇に沈んでいくのに、助かりたくない気分。

title: 午前3時まだ君を待つ
description: A convenience store window, a cold coffee, and you.
descriptionKo: 편의점 창가, 식어버린 커피, 그리고 너.
descriptionJa: コンビニの窓際、冷めたコーヒー、そして君。

title: 最後のキスは嘘
titleEn: The Last Kiss Was a Lie
description: The goodbye that was gentle enough to be a lie.
descriptionJa: 優しすぎて嘘だと分かった、さよならのキス。

title: 午前4時のリピート
description: The same song, the same platform, the same thought — on repeat.
descriptionKo: 같은 노래, 같은 승강장, 같은 생각 — 반복 재생.
descriptionJa: 同じ曲、同じホーム、同じ考え — リピート再生。
